subject: Mathematics

questions.q: Which of the following is equivalent to $(6x + 3y) - (y - 2x)$?
questions.explain: Distribute the negative sign through the second parentheses: $6x + 3y - y + 2x$. Then, combine like terms for $x$: $6x + 2x = 8x$. Combine like terms for $y$: $3y - y = 2y$. The resulting simplified expression is $8x + 2y$.
